guide: You will gain passive progress in this
by having a pet equipped at all times.
Even a Lvl 100 pet counts for this.
To get easy progress in this do
contests like Wheat, Potato, Carrot
or Mushroom as those are easy
Bronze or Silver Medals to get.

note: Gain coins from the Scavenger Enchant
guide: Apply/Use the highest tier of Scavenger
that you can get your hands on and put it
on your main weapon. Gifts from the Jerry Island
can be a way to obtain Scavenger IV books.
You can also use the weapon drops from dungeon mobs
as those have guaranteed Scavenger 5.
For this you need to place down a Chum Bucket
while fishing. It's recommended to use the best rod
you have access to with a Chum Sinker
as this will gain quicker progress.
Purchase it from Moby on the Desert Island.
§cDon't forget to actually deposit the Chum you fish ;)
You can get easy contribution for
this by breaking some Wheat in the Hub.
If you want faster contribution,
make a Sugar Cane farm in your Garden.
Collect those you run along while doing other goals.
If you have trouble check TimeDeo's fairy soul tutorial
on YouTube or use SkyHanni's Fairy Soul Finder.
Mine Pure Lapis Lazuli in the Dwarven Mines
with a Fortune 3+ pickaxe.
You'll want to get as much Mining Speed, Spread,
and Fortune as you can.
You might want to use as many minions
as you have access to for this.
Remember to put a compactor in the minions
when you plan on leaving for a while.
Don't forget to fuel the minions,
give them storages and collect them in time.
Optimally you want to use a weapon with
Luck 5+ and Looting 3+ and aim for
good magic find. Grab the Century Cakes for
+1 Magic Find for 2 days.
For this you will need 1 of each of the following Crystals:
Amethyst: Jungle Key and Temple Run
(the key can be obtained from Odawa as Garden Visitor,
or be bought from her in the Crystal Hollows)
Jade: Divan Mines and find all the tools
Amber: Find King, give him 1 goblin egg and find the Queen
Sapphire Crystal: 6 Robot Parts , give them to Professor Robot
(Electron Transmitter, FTX 3070, Robotron Reflector,
Superlite Motor, Control Switch, Synthetic Heart)
Topaz: Kill the Bal and get the Crystal after it dies,
you need to hit it at least once
§lFor all of this you will need HotM 4.
For this you'll need HotM 4. This goal will
complete alongside Divan's Chance.
You'll need to find a Mines of Divan
and locate all 4 different tools in there
with a Metal Detector and hand them to the
corresponding NPCs.
For this you'll only need to get
Bingo, Grandma Wolf and a Bee pet.
You can use all your minion slots for this,
(buy your daily Obsidian in the End to craft)
mine Ender Nodes and kill Obsidian Defenders.
If you're using minions, make sure to give them
the best fuel and storage you have access to
and collect in time.
The easiest solution here would be
to craft a Wheat Minion t11 (163.632 Wheat).
Utilize the Garden and its pests
to obtain the needed resources.
Use a Jerry Pet and
upgrade it with Kat.
This only takes 10s to upgrade.
Talk to Guildford in the Dungeon Hub
and complete 4/4 objectives of any 2 races.
Don't forget to talk to Guildford
after each run you do.
You will most likely get this passively.
Use /be ingame to view your progress once you
talked to Bramass Beastslayer in The Spiders Den.

note: Obtain a Mediocre Ring of Love
guide: Follow the Romero Questline until you
get this. You will only need
1 Yellow Rock, 15 poppies and 64 Emerald.
This unlocks at 25k Ender Pearl Collection
and requires 32 Enchanted Eyes of Ender
and an Enchanted Diamond to craft.
Don't forget to buy the required Blaze Powder.
Do your daily commissions in the Dwarven Mines
(4 per day). You will need Mining 12 for this.
Can also be completed in the Crystal Hollows,
though it might be harder to do so.

note: Spawn a Golden Goblin from a Goblin Egg
guide: Kill goblins or open loot chests in the Crystal Hollows,
then just throw them until you get a Golden Goblin.
Higher level eggs have higher chances of spawning,
but are also rarer to get.
Claim your cake buff (visit skyerzz, nightlibra or prtl),
hold an angler 4+ rod and visit someone with a
Sea Creature Chance beacon (visit ReyMaratov).
Ideally you want to get 6/8 or more
pieces of the Ender set and a Void Sword
to onetap the Endermen in the End.
§cIsland Endermen do not count for this.
Craft some easy minions while also getting
those that will help with this Bingo.
Use NPC shops to buy materials for easy crafts.
Optimal tool:
Golden Axe or Treecapitator
with Efficiency 5
Reforges: Double-Bit or Lush
Get Haste 3 from a splash to instamine wood
Forage in the Hub for this.
Don't forget to get your Sweep up
if you consider to manually do this.
Place as many minions as you can
give them a medium storage and the best fuel
you can. Collect them in time.
For this you'll want to unlock the Experimentation Table
at Enchanting 10 and play the Daily Games.
